newsitem.title: LATVIA: UNIBANKA, ZEMES TO HOLD PRESS CONFERENCE.
newsitem.headline: UNIBANKA, ZEMES TO HOLD PRESS CONFERENCE.

text.p: Latvian banks Unibanka and Zemes Bank, which have just called off a merger, plan to hold a joint press conference at 1100 am, they said on Tuesday.

The conference, at the training centre of the Unibanka Ridzene branch entrance Kalku and Valnu, will also have the participation of members of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), a key shareholder in both banks.
In a shock move, the two banks called off the merger just as an Unibanka shareholders meeting was due to vote on whether to approve it or not.
